text:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need a tiny, actionable plan to stop repeat OOMs. I propose 3 things: lightweight periodic heap snapshots, a temporary soft-eviction threshold, and a dashboard for fragmentation signals.

dinesh: I can take snapshots. Will do 30s sampled summaries with top-10 allocation sites. Target proto by Thu. Will keep CPU overhead <2%.

ada: I'll implement the soft-eviction hook. Suggest trigger at 90% residency with a 45s debounce and background reclaim. Canary on shard-3 for 1h.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled on shard-3 by ada @2800100015.

henry: I'll add fragmentation metric (run-occupancy ratio) and a dashboard heatmap. Also set alert: residency >= 85% for 10m -> annotate for triage.

maria: Owners & deadlines:
- dinesh -> heap snapshots proto by 2800100860 (Thu EOD)
- ada -> soft-eviction canary start @2800100015 and roll decision by 2800104200
- henry -> fragmentation panel + alert by 2800101800

dinesh: Implementation note: snapshots will be uploaded to s3 with TTL 14d and KMS encryption. Example: /kv-profiles/{ts}-{shard}.json.gz

ada: We'll expose soft-eviction flag for SRE to adjust. During canary we'll collect p95 latency, eviction rate, and failed alloc count. Abort criteria: tail latency increase >30% or failed allocs not improving.

henry: Dashboard panels: residency timeline, fragmentation ratio, failed allocs. Will link snapshots when available.

maria: Risk: snapshots can add noise during peak. Dinesh: gate snapshoting on cpu <70% and QPS thresholds.

dinesh: ack. We'll have a fallback to reduce sampling to 0.1% if load high.

ada: After canary we'll meet Fri to review metrics and decide rollout.

maria: I'll update the postmortem actions doc and create the tracker ticket. Thanks everyone.

ops-bot: reminder-bot: reminder scheduled for canary review @2800104200.
